human_quote: Je valide CP01–CP06 et tes propositions de clarification. Enregistre mes décisions, clarifie G05 et prépare la spécification de l’interface avant l’implémentation. Aucun LLM, API payante, commit ni push.
approval_basis: One actual collective human message, not six or eleven independent approval events.

approved_protocol_decisions.CP01: Structured control and unassisted text use one common downstream method, catalog/source policy and per-request six-root/2048-token budget.
approved_protocol_decisions.CP02: Twelve known P development anchors and six semantic G controls have separate reporting; original S approvals do not approve every new text/origin mapping.
approved_protocol_decisions.CP03: Preserve verbatim text, real origins, competing assertions and scoped ambiguity without coercion to valid JSON.
approved_protocol_decisions.CP04: Exact critical-meaning and context/diagnostic gates; zero hard source/resource violations, no always-clarify shortcut, no dropped failures.
approved_protocol_decisions.CP05: Freeze the candidate before authoring a new twelve-intent bilingual prospective set; review exact references before one preserved run without post-result tuning.
approved_protocol_decisions.CP06: Start with a deterministic local interpreter; defer real human confirmation and generated-answer evaluation as separate arms/stages.

approved_preceding_clarifications.CL01: Separate interpretation issue/origin ledger from the current structured input; retain non-dispatched units in the whole-request outcome rather than claim coverage by omission.
approved_preceding_clarifications.CL02: Declare a limited EN/FR construction perimeter and scope unsupported-input diagnostics; do not claim arbitrary language understanding.
approved_preceding_clarifications.CL03: Score meaning through reviewed aliases while retaining literal words, quantities, uncertainty and valid origins; ID renaming cannot change ownership.
approved_preceding_clarifications.CL04: Clarify G05 so unresolved A/B ownership is explicit, not dependent on a debatable nearest-pronoun reading.
approved_preceding_clarifications.CL05: Preserve the current structured method. A necessary common-method change requires a separately versioned baseline and conformance evidence.

before.family: Unresolved pronoun with independent general request
before.text_en: A uses HiTrap Blue HP 1 mL and B uses HiTrap Blue HP 5 mL. What washing flow should be used for it? Independently, C asks for the general SEC principle.
before.text_fr: A utilise HiTrap Blue HP 1 mL et B utilise HiTrap Blue HP 5 mL. Quel débit de lavage utiliser pour celle-ci ? Indépendamment, C demande le principe général de la SEC.
before.draft_expected_meaning: The washing owner is ambiguous between A and B and requires clarification, preserving both candidates. C general SEC/principle remains independent.
before.limits: Do not resolve by closest mention, merge A/B or invent two positive washing requests. Do not force an unresolved-owner issue into a misleading valid form.

after.family: Unresolved pronoun with independent general request
after.text_en: A uses HiTrap Blue HP 1 mL and B uses HiTrap Blue HP 5 mL. For washing, I refer to one of these two preparations without specifying whether A or B. What flow applies to that preparation? Independently, C asks for the general SEC principle.
after.text_fr: A utilise HiTrap Blue HP 1 mL et B utilise HiTrap Blue HP 5 mL. Pour le lavage, je parle de l’une de ces deux préparations sans préciser si c’est A ou B. Quel débit s’applique à cette préparation ? Indépendamment, C demande le principe général de la SEC.
after.draft_expected_meaning: The washing owner is ambiguous between A and B and requires clarification, preserving both candidates. C general SEC/principle remains independent.
after.limits: The input explicitly leaves the washing owner unresolved between A and B. Preserve both candidates without selecting the latest mention, merging A/B or inventing two positive requests. C remains independent; no misleading valid form is fabricated.
after.revision_basis: Actual collective protocol approval requests G05 clarification; exact revised wording and origin annotations still await case review.

G05_revision.scope: Clarified wording only; exact revised case/origin review remains pending; no executed result or new source reference.

not_approved_or_performed: No approval inferred for the newly drafted FI01-FI06 interface choices or IF01-IF14 fixtures.
No completed P/G text/form/origin review or prospective dataset approval.
No interpreter, runtime/schema change, candidate freeze, comparison execution or source-policy change.
No model/API call, Git commit or push.
